trace.text:
To determine which zip codes can host power generation facilities that supply "regional green electricity" to consumers in a specific zip code, you can use the `entnahme` endpoint of the Regional Power Origin Concept tool.

For your example zip code **88888**, the system indicates that this zip code is not contained in the database. This means there is currently no regional mapping data available for that specific zip code in the dataset (data status: 2021).

In general, when a valid zip code is provided, this tool returns a comprehensive list of all zip codes within the defined regional radius. Any generation facility located within those returned zip codes is eligible to have its electricity labeled as regional green electricity for consumers located in the requested zip code.
